2105-4460-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4460-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4460-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1385-4279-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-4279-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

710-4247-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-4247-8207.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

215-1251-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-1251-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1400-4247-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-4247-4619.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

4681-4894-6542-8095.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

413-1011-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
413-1011-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-1011-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

997-3249-5111-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

2615-4460-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-4460-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

2511-6249-7256--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2511-6249-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

225-539-1460-3634.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
225-539-1460-3634.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Venser trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Vault of Catlacan.
Repeat.
225-539-1460-3634.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

4311-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
4311-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

586-2292-5060-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-2292-5060-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

549-1365-4853-6798--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-4853-6798--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

224-5627-6662.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-5627-6662.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2438-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2438-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1322-2105-3204-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1322-2105-3204-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

799-1750-1979-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one legendary creature and/or planeswalker.
Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
799-1750-1979-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Karn's Temporal Sundering from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Karn's Temporal Sundering from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4417-5708-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
2034-4417-5708-5944.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher, adding {C}{C}.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Unstoppable Slasher trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2} and 2 life, removing both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher and giving Hex Parasite +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

112-698-889-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
112-698-889-4050.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Will's ability, targeting any permanent.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fractal, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

301-2034-2775-2850.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
301-2034-2775-2850.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Putrid Goblin dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2060-2854-4518-4772.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2854-4518-4772.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Kor Skyfisher triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

186-239-1700-4385.description:
All slivers have haste.
Tap a Sliver to generate {1}.
Use that mana to create a Sliver with Sliver Queen's ability.
Use the newly created Sliver to repeat the cycle.
